create_GaussianSmearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to encode atom distances using Gaussian basis functions with configurable start, stop, and width
create_SigmoidSmearing: create a SigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid basis functions with configurable range and width
create_LinearSigmoidSmearing: create a LinearSigmoidSmearing module to encode atom distances using sigmoid plus linear residual for improved gradient flow
create_SiLUSmearing: create a SiLUSmearing module to encode atom distances using a learnable linear layer followed by SiLU activation
test_smearing_forward: test the forward pass of any smearing class by passing a distance tensor and verifying output shape
